_help: Manual matches. Key: the staff e-mail (or instructor uid). "openalex": OpenAlex author IDs (https://openalex.org/authors/A...); "scopus": Scopus author IDs (https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=...). Use this when a researcher shows 'يحتاج تحقق' or 'غير مطابق', or when a source split one person into several profiles. Saving this file rebuilds the research data.
